chunks.text:
[Intro]
{stepping through the great doors: one awed hit of timpani and full organ chord, then the sound settles at once into a hushed choir and the processional bass}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
D minor turning to F major
soft sampled pipe organ carrying a reverent melody
processional synth bass walking in half notes
quiet timpani rolls leading each phrase
reverent, anticipatory, cool stone hall interior
